title: Multimodal Generative AI and Foundation Models for Behavioural Health in Online Gambling

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not empirically measure model bias directly; rather, it conducts a narrative review and structural evaluation of existing literature. It uses requirement mapping (visualized via an UpSet plot) to assess the extent to which algorithmic fairness and social biases—specifically the risk of AI interventions performing poorly for underrepresented minority and demographic groups—are addressed across current AI applications for problem gambling.
